## About

Explainable PhaseNet provides a maintained framework for understanding the waveform evidence behind PhaseNet detections [@abdullin2026xai]. It implements waveform Grad-CAM, exact component-wise Shapley values, SHAP-gated inference, and controlled noise-robustness experiments.

## Why it matters

Event detectors can appear confident for the wrong reasons, especially under pump noise or low signal-to-noise ratios. Explanations help researchers inspect phase sensitivity and use contribution patterns to reduce false alarms.

## Key result and audience

The repository reproduces the central manuscript workflows and figures, bundles tested model code, and supplies lightweight synthetic-fixture tests when large datasets are unavailable. It serves microseismic monitoring teams and researchers in trustworthy geoscience AI.
